title: 四圣谛现观
note: 苦应知、集应断、灭应证、道应修

evidence.pali: ‘‘Yāvakīvañca me, bhikkhave, imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evaṃ tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādasākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi, neva tāvāhaṃ, bhikkhave , sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya ‘anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho’ti paccaññāsiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.) .
evidence.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，只要我于此四圣谛，如此三转、十二行相的如实智见尚未完全清净，诸比丘，我就决不在有天神、有魔罗、有梵天的世间，于有沙门、婆罗门、有天、有人的众生中，宣称我已现正觉无上正等觉。”
evidence.english: Bhikkhus, as long as my knowledge and vision of things as they really are regarding these Four Noble Truths—with their three rounds and twelve aspects—was not thoroughly purified, I did not declare to the world with its devas, Māra, and Brahmā, to this generation with its ascetics and brahmins, its devas and humans, that I had fully awakened to the unsurpassed, perfect enlightenment.

entries.pali: Tathā saccādhiṭṭhānasamudāgamena ariyassa sīlakkhandhassa anubodhappaṭivedhasiddhi, cāgādhiṭṭhānasamudāgamena ariyassa samādhikkhandhassa, paññādhiṭṭhānasamudāgamena ariyassa paññākkhandhassa, upasamādhiṭṭhānasamudāgamena ariyassa vimuttikkhandhassa anubodhappaṭivedhasiddhi dīpitā hoti. Saccādhiṭṭhānaparipūraṇena ca tapasiddhi, cāgādhiṭṭhānaparipūraṇena sabbanissaggasiddhi, upasamādhiṭṭhānaparipūraṇena indriyasaṃvarasiddhi, paññādhiṭṭhānaparipūraṇena buddhisiddhi, tena ca nibbānasiddhi. Tathā saccādhiṭṭhānaparipūraṇena catuariyasaccābhisamayappaṭilābho, cāgādhiṭṭhānaparipūraṇena catuariyavaṃsappaṭilābho, 0.upasamādhiṭṭhānaparipūraṇena catuariyavihārappaṭilābho, paññādhiṭṭhānaparipūraṇena catuariyavohārappaṭilābho dīpito hoti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 如是，依于谛决意的成就，阐明了圣戒蕴之随觉与通达的成就；依于施决意的成就，阐明了圣定蕴之随觉与通达的成就；依于慧决意的成就，阐明了圣慧蕴之随觉与通达的成就；依于寂止决意的成就，阐明了圣解脱蕴之随觉与通达的成就。又，依于谛决意的圆满，则成就苦行；依于施决意的圆满，则成就一切舍弃；依于寂止决意的圆满，则成就根律仪；依于慧决意的圆满，则成就智慧，并由此成就涅槃。如是，依于谛决意的圆满，阐明了四圣谛现观的获得；依于施决意的圆满，阐明了四圣种的获得；依于寂止决意的圆满，阐明了四圣住的获得；依于慧决意的圆满，阐明了四无碍解的获得。
entries.english: Thus, through the arising of the determination to truth, the accomplishment of awakening to and penetrating the noble aggregate of virtue; through the arising of the determination to relinquishment, the noble aggregate of concentration; through the arising of the determination to wisdom, the noble aggregate of wisdom; and through the arising of the determination to tranquility, the accomplishment of awakening to and penetrating the noble aggregate of liberation is illuminated. And by the fulfillment of the determination to truth, the accomplishment of ascetic practice is achieved; by the fulfillment of the determination to relinquishment, the accomplishment of complete relinquishment is achieved; by the fulfillment of the determination to tranquility, the accomplishment of sense-restraint is achieved; by the fulfillment of the determination to wisdom, the accomplishment of understanding is achieved, and thereby, the accomplishment of Nibbāna. Thus, by the fulfillment of the determination to truth, the attainment of the direct knowledge of the Four Noble Truths is illuminated; by the fulfillment of the determination to relinquishment, the attainment of the four Noble Lineages is illuminated; by the fulfillment of the determination to tranquility, the attainment of the four Noble Dwellings is illuminated; and by the fulfillment of the determination to wisdom, the attainment of the four Noble Discourses is illuminated.

entries.pali: Atha vā gativimutta nti anupādisesanibbānadhātuppattiyā bhagavantaṃ thometi. Ettha hi dvīhi ākārehi bhagavato thomanā veditabbā attahitasampattito parahitapaṭipattito ca. Tesu attahitasampatti anāvaraṇañāṇādhigamato savāsanānaṃ sabbesaṃ kilesānaṃ accantappahānato anupādisesanibbānappattito ca veditabbā, parahitapaṭipatti lābhasakkārādinirapekkhacittassa sabbadukkhaniyyānikadhammadesanato viruddhesupi niccaṃ hitajjhāsayato ñāṇaparipākakālāgamanato ca. Sā panettha āsayato payogato ca duvidhā parahitapaṭipatti, tividhā ca attahitasampatti pakāsitā hoti. Kathaṃ? ‘‘Karuṇāsītalahadaya’’nti etena āsayato parahitapaṭipatti, sammāgadanatthena sugatasaddena payogato parahitapaṭipatti, ‘‘paññāpajjotavihatamohatamaṃ gativimutta’’nti etehi catusaccapaṭivedhatthena ca sugatasaddena tividhāpi attahitasampatti, avasiṭṭhaṭṭhena tena ‘‘paññāpajjotavihatamohatama’’nti etena cāpi sabbāpi attahitasampattiparahitapaṭipatti pakāsitā hotīti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 或者说，“解脱诸趣”是为赞叹世尊证得无余依涅槃界。此处应从两种方面理解对世尊的赞叹：自利成就与利他行持。其中自利成就应理解为：证得无障碍智、彻底断除一切烦恼及其习气、证得无余依涅槃；利他行持则应理解为：心不贪求利养恭敬、宣说能解脱一切苦之法、对违逆者亦恒常怀有利益之心、等待众生智慧成熟之时。此中，利他行持从发心与行持两方面分为两种，自利成就则开显为三种。如何而言？“慈悲清凉心”一句显示发心层面的利他行持；“善逝”一词以善说之义，显示行持层面的利他行持；“以智慧之灯破除痴暗”、“解脱诸趣”等句，以及“善逝”一词以四圣谛现观之义，显示三种自利成就；而以“无余依”之义，以及“以智慧之灯破除痴暗”一句，亦显示一切自利成就与利他行持。
entries.english: Alternatively, ‘freed from destinations’ praises the Blessed One for his attainment of the Nibbāna-element without residue remaining. Here, the praise of the Blessed One should be understood in two ways: through the accomplishment of his own welfare and through his practice for the welfare of others. Among these, the accomplishment of his own welfare is to be understood from his attainment of unobstructed knowledge, his utter abandonment of all defilements with their latent tendencies, and his attainment of the Nibbāna-element without residue. His practice for the welfare of others is to be understood from his teaching the Dhamma that leads out from all suffering with a mind unconcerned with gain and honor, from his constant disposition of welfare even toward the hostile, and from his awaiting the time for the ripening of knowledge in his disciples. Here, that practice for the welfare of others is shown to be twofold, by disposition and by application, while the accomplishment of his own welfare is shown to be threefold. How so? By ‘with a heart cooled by compassion,’ the practice for others’ welfare by disposition is shown. By the word ‘Sugata’ in the sense of speaking rightly, the practice for others’ welfare by application is shown. By the phrases ‘who has dispelled the darkness of delusion with the light of wisdom’ and ‘freed from destinations,’ and by the word ‘Sugata’ in its sense of penetrating the Four Truths, the threefold accomplishment of his own welfare is shown. And by the remaining meaning of the phrase ‘who has dispelled the darkness of delusion with the light of wisdom,’ all aspects of both the accomplishment of his own welfare and the practice for the welfare of others are revealed.

path: 雷迪西亚多著作集 Leḍī-Sayāḍo-Gantha-Saṅgaho
entries.pali: ‘‘Taṃ nasundara’’nti byañjanato nasundaraṃ. Nakevalaṃ byañjanatoyeva nasundaraṃ, atthatopi nasundarameva. Catusacca dhammāhi paccekabuddhaññāṇassapi gocarā honti. Pañcañeyya dhammā pana sabbaññutaññāṇasseva. Tattha catusacca dhammā nāma paramattha dhammā eva. Pañcañeyyadhammā pana sabba paññattiyā saha sabbaparamattha dhammā. Sabbaññubuddhānaṃ catusaccābhi sambodho dhamma paññattiyā saha sijjhati. Paccekabuddhānaṃ catusacca sambodho dhammapaññattiyā saha nasijjhati. Tasmā te sayaṃ paṭividdhaṃ catusacca dhammaṃ nāma paññattiṃ nīharitvā paresaṃ desetuṃ na sakkonti. Tesaṃ catusaccasambodho mūgassa supinadassanaṃ viya hotīti aṭṭhakathāsu vuttaṃ. Tasmā paññattiyā saha pañca ñeyya dhammā eva sabbaññutaññāṇassa gocarāti sakkāvattunti.
entries.chinese_simplified: “那不美妙”这句话从字面上看是不美妙的。不仅从字面上不美妙，从意义上也是不美妙的。四圣谛法是独觉佛智的行境，而五所知法则仅是遍知佛智的行境。于此，四圣谛法即是胜义法，而五所知法则是包含一切施设与一切胜义法。诸遍知佛陀对四圣谛的现观，是连同法施设一同成就的；诸独觉佛陀对四圣谛的现观，则不能连同法施设一同成就。因此，他们无法将自己所证悟的四圣谛法，以名言施设为他人宣说。他们的四圣谛现观，犹如哑人梦有所见，诚如义注中所说。是故，唯有连同施设的五所知法才是遍知佛智的行境——此理得以成立。
entries.english: “‘That is not beautiful’ means it is not beautiful in terms of the letter. Not only is it not beautiful in terms of the letter, but it is also not beautiful in terms of the meaning. The four truths are also a domain for the knowledge of Paccekabuddhas. The five knowables, however, are the domain of omniscient knowledge alone. Herein, the phenomena of the four truths are only ultimate phenomena. But the five knowables are all ultimate phenomena together with all conventional designations. For Omniscient Buddhas, the full awakening to the four truths is accomplished together with the conventional designation of the Dhamma. For Paccekabuddhas, the awakening to the four truths is not accomplished together with the conventional designation of the Dhamma. Therefore, they are unable to bring forth the conventional designation named ‘the four truths,’ which they have personally penetrated, and teach it to others. Their awakening to the four truths is like the dream seen by a mute person, as it is said in the commentaries. Therefore, it can be said that only the five knowables together with conventional designations are the domain of omniscient knowledge.”

entries.pali: ‘‘Ye pana te, mahārāja, bhikkhū catusaccābhisamayappaṭividdhā diṭṭhasaccā viññātasāsanā catūsu sāmaññaphalesu tiṇṇavicikicchā paṭiladdhaphalasukhā aññesampi paṭipannānaṃ te phale saṃvibhajanti, evarūpā kho, mahārāja, bhikkhū bhagavato dhammanagare ‘phalāpaṇikā’ ti vuccanti.
entries.chinese_simplified: “再者，大王，有些比丘已于四圣谛现观通达、已见真谛、已领悟教法、于四沙门果断除怀疑、已获得果乐，亦与其他修行者分享此果。大王，在世尊的法城中，这样的比丘被称为‘果商’。”
entries.english: “But those monks, great king, who have penetrated the four noble truths, who have seen the truths, understood the teaching, crossed beyond doubt in regard to the four fruits of recluseship, attained the bliss of the fruits, and who share those fruits with others who are practicing—such monks, great king, are called ‘fruit-sellers’ in the Blessed One’s city of Dhamma.”
